$comment: The five magic treasures, name and effect verbatim from the spoiler-gated section of page a2 ('Read this if you want to know the treasure's way of working'). Three are a foe's loot; the gourd and the vase are picked up by exploration, not loot (I-38). `knownFrom` is what reveals the effect short of holding the treasure: the Chieftain's scattered sheets explain two of them - the fan and the gourd, a guess (I-38b) - and the Old Vixen knows the Cord's spells (I-41). The printed name of the fan is 'Plantain Fan' here and 'Plantain fan' on the Senior King's LOOT line; both spellings are in the source and both are kept where they are printed.
title: The 5 Treasures: the treasures
label: rule

records.name: Gold and red gourd
records.effect: if opened it will swallow the sky, changing day to night. Close it to have the daylight back.

records.name: Dazzling Golden Cord
records.effect: with a spell it moves to tie a person. Another spell unties. It can't be cut with normal weapons.

records.name: Vase of muttonfat jade
records.effect: remove the label and call out a person's name, if they respond they'll be trapped inside.

records.name: Plantain Fan
records.effect: it creates magic-fire's waves inextinguishable using conventional methods.

records.name: Seven-star sword
records.effect: magical and indestructible weapon. It can block hits from stronger enemies without any effort from the holder.
